elements.name: setup
elements.brief: Sets up the tile map to cast rays through, replacing any previous one.
elements.description: Sets up the tile map to cast rays through, replacing any previous one.

parameters.name: tilemap_width
parameters.doc: Number of tiles horizontally in the tile map.

parameters.name: tilemap_height
parameters.doc: Number of tiles vertically in the tile map.

parameters.name: tiles
parameters.doc: One-dimensional table of tile IDs, row by row.

parameters.name: target_tiles
parameters.doc: IDs of the tiles a ray stops at, such as walls.

elements.name: cast
elements.brief: Casts a ray through the tile map and reports the first target tile it
elements.description:
Casts a ray through the tile map and reports the first target tile it
hits. A miss returns `false` alone, so check `hit` before reading the
other values. Before `setup`, it logs an error and returns nothing.

parameters.name: from_x
parameters.doc: X coordinate of the ray start.

parameters.name: from_y
parameters.doc: Y coordinate of the ray start.

parameters.name: to_x
parameters.doc: X coordinate of the ray end.

parameters.name: to_y
parameters.doc: Y coordinate of the ray end.

returnvalues.doc:
`hit`, then on a hit: `tile_x`, `tile_y`, `array_id` (index in the
tile table), `tile_id`, `intersection_x`, `intersection_y` and `side`
(`LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `TOP` or `BOTTOM`).
types: LuaMultiReturn<[ false ] | [ true, number, number, number, number, number, number, number ]>

Returns the tile ID at a tile coordinate. The extension registers its

reverse of what its documentation describes.

returnvalues.doc: The tile ID at that coordinate.
